# COR070 `missing-default-case`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A `select case` construct has no `case default`.

## Why

When no case matches, a `select case` without `case default` does nothing, silently. A value that
was not foreseen (a new option, a corrupted input) then flows on unhandled. Add `case default`, even
if only to stop with an error that names the unexpected value.

## Reported

```fortran
select case (scheme)
case ('weno5')
  call weno5(q)
case ('weno7')
  call weno7(q)
end select
```

## Preferred

```fortran
select case (scheme)
case ('weno5')
  call weno5(q)
case ('weno7')
  call weno7(q)
case default
  error stop 'unknown scheme: '//scheme
end select
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR070] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR070` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `C011` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
